package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

type Animal interface {
	Sound() string
}

type Base struct{ Name string }

func (b Base) Describe() string { return "I am " + b.Name }

type Dog struct {
	Base
	Age int `json:"age"`
}

func (d Dog) Sound() string { return "woof" }

type Order struct {
	ID    string   `json:"id"`
	Items []string `json:"items,omitempty"`
	Total int64    `json:"total_cents"`
	note  string
}

type Celsius float64

func (c Celsius) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f°C", float64(c)) }

type Number interface{ ~int | ~float64 }

func Sum[T Number](xs []T) T {
	var s T
	for _, x := range xs {
		s += x
	}
	return s
}

func Map[T, U any](xs []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	out := make([]U, 0, len(xs))
	for _, x := range xs {
		out = append(out, f(x))
	}
	return out
}

type Stack[T any] struct{ items []T }

func (s *Stack[T]) Push(v T) { s.items = append(s.items, v) }
func (s *Stack[T]) Pop() (T, bool) {
	var zero T
	if len(s.items) == 0 {
		return zero, false
	}
	v := s.items[len(s.items)-1]
	s.items = s.items[:len(s.items)-1]
	return v, true
}

func classify(v any) string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case nil:
		return "nil"
	case int:
		return fmt.Sprintf("int %d", x)
	case string:
		return "string " + strings.ToUpper(x)
	case error:
		return "error " + x.Error()
	case fmt.Stringer:
		return "stringer " + x.String()
	default:
		return fmt.Sprintf("other %T", x)
	}
}

func divide(a, b int) (q int, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("recovered: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	return a / b, nil
}

func main() {
	d := Dog{Base: Base{Name: "Rex"}, Age: 3}
	var a Animal = d
	fmt.Println(d.Describe(), a.Sound(), d.Name)

	b, _ := json.Marshal(Order{ID: "o1", Total: 1999, note: "x"})
	fmt.Println(string(b))
	var o Order
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"id":"o2","items":["a","b"],"total_cents":5}`), &o)
	fmt.Println(o.ID, o.Items, o.Total, err)
	db, _ := json.Marshal(d)
	fmt.Println(string(db))

	fmt.Println(Celsius(21.5))
	fmt.Println(Sum([]int{1, 2, 3}), Sum([]float64{1.5, 2}))
	fmt.Println(Map([]int{1, 2, 3}, func(i int) string { return strings.Repeat("*", i) }))
	var s Stack[string]
	s.Push("x")
	s.Push("y")
	v, ok := s.Pop()
	fmt.Println(v, ok)

	fmt.Println(classify(nil), "|", classify(7), "|", classify("go"), "|", classify(errors.New("bad")), "|", classify(Celsius(3)), "|", classify(3.5))
	fmt.Println(divide(7, 2))
	fmt.Println(divide(1, 0))

	people := []struct {
		Name string
		Age  int
	}{{"Ann", 30}, {"Bob", 25}, {"Cid", 30}}
	sort.SliceStable(people, func(i, j int) bool { return people[i].Age < people[j].Age })
	fmt.Println(people)

	m := map[string][]int{}
	m["a"] = append(m["a"], 1, 2)
	fmt.Println(len(m["a"]), m["zz"] == nil)

	const (
		Pending = iota
		Paid
		Shipped
	)
	fmt.Println(Pending, Paid, Shipped)

outer:
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		for j := 0; j < 3; j++ {
			if j == 2 {
				continue outer
			}
			if i == 2 {
				break outer
			}
			fmt.Print(i, j, " ")
		}
	}
	fmt.Println()
	for i, r := range "héllo" {
		fmt.Print(i, ":", string(r), " ")
	}
	fmt.Println()
	fn := d.Sound
	fmt.Println(fn(), fmt.Sprintf("%v %v", d, o))
}
